text:
The dish is a paper plate, probably about 20-22 cm across, and it holds three avocado wedges that look like roughly a quarter to a third of an avocado each.

Together the wedges look like about one whole avocado, or a bit less. An avocado with the skin on weighs around 200 g, and the edible flesh is about 140 g. The wedges still appear to have their skin, so the visible total is about 170 g, of which roughly 130 g is flesh.

Avocado flesh is about 1.6 kcal/g, so 130 g comes to about 210 kcal.
